notes: AV1 only: run on the build box (release builds) on 2026-11-27 at ec8cd468b (branch argon-av1-fix, landed with this record; Argon from a build of the same tree with one clippy-only difference). The other codecs' record is conformance-2026-11-23. Earlier runs of this record (git history): Argon profile 0 790/889 at d489618bb, 889/889 at 7d892c578.

Argon: all 3343 streams of 18 sets pass: profiles 0, 1 and 2, each with the core, core special, not-Annex-B, not-Annex-B special and stress sets (3008 streams) matching aomdec --rawvideo (our decoder with --unbounded 1 --monochrome-chroma 0), and the error sets (335 invalid streams) decoding robustly: no panic, signal or timeout. The 61 profile 0 mismatches of the first run had two causes, both fixed: lossless blocks' chroma in the loop filter (686d593c1) and intra block copy at the frame edge (ed8b70b46). All profile 1 and 2 streams matched without a change. The large scale tile sets (an exception) were not run.

av1.denominator: libaom v3.15.3 Main-profile test vectors: the 176 av1-1-b8-* and 66 av1-1-b10-* (tools/conformance/av1_manifest.txt), film grain applied
